# setup-ts-deep-modules

> Wire dependency-cruiser into a TypeScript repo so each package is a deep module — implementation hidden in subfolders, reachable only through its entry-point files. User-invoked.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install HukuKaich0u/agent-kit/skills/in-progress/setup-ts-deep-modules
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - HukuKaich0u/agent-kit/skills/in-progress/setup-ts-deep-modules
```

then run `apm install`.
